readiness.geographic_compatibility: Communities (about 300) nest in 14 wards; 2021 Census tables are published by community.
readiness.historical_coverage: Property roll: current year only (year of construction gives a build history). 311 from 2010.
readiness.update_frequency: Assets weekly to monthly; property roll yearly.

readiness.data_availability: High for this module: neighbourhoods, wards, every residential property with location and year built, playgrounds, parks, transit stops, community league halls, recreation centres, libraries, 2021 Census by neighbourhood (age included). Also published: 311 requests, building and development permits, schools.
readiness.data_quality: High. Apartment buildings are one account each, so their homes are estimated from floor area (Calgary uses building permits). About 7,600 homes have no neighbourhood code on the roll and are placed by location. Four 2021 Census neighbourhoods have since been renamed or renumbered; their residents are placed by the census-day boundary.
readiness.geographic_compatibility: Neighbourhoods (about 400, including industrial ones) in 12 named wards. Neighbourhoods are not equivalent to Calgary's communities: compare cities only at the city level.
readiness.historical_coverage: Property roll: current year (year built gives the build history). 311 from 2014. Census 2021 by neighbourhood; municipal censuses 2009 to 2019.
readiness.indicator_comparability: The access, crowding and score measures use the same method, thresholds and rules as Calgary. Population differs: Calgary uses Calgary Data Desk's estimates, Edmonton the 2021 Census plus new homes. Scores are against each city's own level, so they are not comparable between cities; shares of homes within reach are.
readiness.update_frequency: Assets weekly; property roll yearly; census every five years.
readiness.not_yet: City dashboard figures (311, crime, permits, schools) are not built for Edmonton yet.
